'''Team Awesome''' is the name on a Dark Side and a Light Side ''Star Wars'' CCG decklist from the Team event of the [[2007 World Championship]]. It is written beside a crossed-out player name.<ref name="team">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+Team.pdf 2007 Worlds Team.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203555/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2007/Worlds/2007+Worlds+Team.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The person or people who played under this name are not identified. The open question and the sheet images are listed at [[Talk:Team Awesome]].
